Company Release - 10/29/2026 CACI Awarded $185 Million U.S. Army Task Order to Advance Expeditionary Power and Mission Readiness


RESTON, Va.


, Oct. 29, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- CACI International Inc ([NYSE: CACI](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806605-1&h=3423871367&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nyse.com%2Fquote%2FXNYS%3ACACI&a=NYSE%3A+CACI) ) announced today that it has been awarded a five-year task order valued at up to $185 million to support the U.S. Army's Program Manager Expeditionary Energy and Sustainment Systems (PM E2S2). CACI will develop and integrate technologies that help soldiers sustain operations in contested and austere environments.


Under this contract, CACI will advance expeditionary systems that enable Army forces to operate longer and maintain mission effectiveness when access to infrastructure, supply networks, and positioning systems is limited or disrupted.


"Soldiers need dependable equipment and systems that allow them to operate effectively, regardless of the conditions they face," said[John Mengucci](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806605-1&h=1047651406&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2Fbio%2Fjohn-s-mengucci&a=John+Mengucci) , CACI President and Chief Executive Officer. "Our work will help the Army reduce its dependence on traditional infrastructure and give soldiers greater flexibility to accomplish their missions in challenging environments."


CACI will conduct research, development, testing, and evaluation across a range of expeditionary technologies, including power generation and distribution, environmental control systems, GPS-denied long-range cargo airdrop, multispectral camouflage, protected shelters, field sustainment, and advanced sensing technologies and software.


**About CACI**


CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.
